title: Warehouse generator v3 DEV pilot WH8-A: pre-registration (written before the candidate was generated or checked)
recorded_by: Claude Code session, requested by ina823
split_intent: DEV (development side). NOT registered in registry/instances_v1.jsonl by this step; no split is changed.
predictions_status: hand-derived from the layout parameters and the in-memory layout scan of design doc section 3 (worst case: every top-row and bottom-row cell as a goal). Agent cells were not known when this file was written.

selection_rule.no_replacement: The candidate is not replaced, dropped or re-seeded because of a result.
selection_rule.failures_are_kept: A missed prediction is recorded as such; this file is not edited afterwards.
selection_rule.cbs: CBS is not run in this step.
selection_rule.il: No IL episode is run in this step; only the t=0 observation is built for the IL input check.

check_criteria.validity: Grid is 0/1 int64; every start and goal is inside the grid on a free cell; starts distinct; goals distinct.
check_criteria.agent_id: JSON agent_id equals the list index for every agent; the runtime id is the list index.
check_criteria.coordinates: JSON [x, y] read through scenario_loader equals the generator's internal (row, col).
check_criteria.actions: spec.ACTION_DELTA equals the simulator's action table for ids 0..4, and every move on one BFS shortest path per agent converts to an action id in 0..3 via spec.delta_to_action.
check_criteria.seed_reproducibility: Two generations with the same seed are byte-identical, also across PYTHONHASHSEED 0 and 1.
check_criteria.il_ood: il_compat.check_instance + quality_gate.classify_ood against registry/il_input_reference_v1.json; status and class are recorded with their bounds; auto_fail stays False.
check_criteria.registry: registry.relate against every record + Registry.evaluate(candidate, 'DEV') in memory only; registry/instances_v1.jsonl sha256 equal before and after. Every automatic relation is a HOLD with final_decision null. Nothing is written into registry/.
check_criteria.width1_cell_definition: A free cell whose two up/down neighbours are both wall-or-outside, or whose two left/right neighbours are both wall-or-outside.

predicted.ood_note: Boundary values: worst-case goal_col reaches -12 (= p0.5) and wall_count reaches 17 (= p99.5); both are inside by the inclusive check. robot_count <= 3 and other_goal_count <= 4 at t=0 by construction (4 agents per start row; the only goals within 2 rows of a start row are the 4 on the adjacent edge row).
predicted.automatic_relations_note: Hand check only: no existing map is expected to be a window of this layout or contain it. To be computed, not assumed.
